info.title: CIHub API
info.description:
The API of a CIHub instance: read the queues, the PRs in them and their runs; submit, cancel and restart a PR; pause, drain and resume a queue. The dashboard and the `cihub` command line use it too. The API is at `/api/v1` on the address of the instance, next to the dashboard.

## Authentication

Send an API token of the organization in the header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. `cihub server token create --org <slug>` creates the first one. A token has scopes:

| Scope          | Allows                                                     |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `queues:read`  | Read the queues, their PRs and their runs                  |
| `queues:write` | Pause, drain, resume and read again a queue; read the audit log |
| `prs:write`    | Submit, cancel and restart a PR                            |

The dashboard uses the session of a person instead: the cookie `__Host-cihub_session`. The role of the person in the organization of the URL gives the scopes: `admin` has every scope, `member` has `queues:read` and `prs:write`. A request of a session that can change a state (any method but `GET`, `HEAD` and `OPTIONS`) also sends the header `X-CSRF-Token`, with the value of the cookie `__Host-cihub_csrf`.

## Names in the URL

A route names the organization by its slug, then the repository and the queue by their names: `/orgs/acme/repos/web/queues/main`. A PR belongs to its repository: `/orgs/acme/repos/web/prs/118`; its base branch gives its queue. The case of the slug and of the repository does not matter. An organization that the token or the person does not belong to answers `404 org_not_found`, as one that does not exist.

## Requests that the queue does later

A submission, a cancellation, a restart, a change of the state of a queue and a new read of a queue answer `202 Accepted`, without a body: the queue applies them at its next reconciliation, within seconds. `GET /orgs/{org}/stream` tells when a queue changed.

## Pages

A list gives a page. `limit` asks for 1 to 100 entries (50 by default), and `from` takes the `cursor` of the previous page. The answer names its entries after the resource (`prs`, `queues`, …) and adds:

| Field      | Meaning                                                              |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `has_more` | More entries follow this page                                        |
| `count`    | How many entries the list has, every page together                   |
| `cursor`   | The `from` of the next page; `null` on the last page. It is opaque: pass it back as it is |

A cursor of another list, or one that does not read, answers `400 invalid_cursor`.

## Rate limits

A token or a session makes at most 600 requests per minute on each replica of the server; past it, the answer is `429 rate_limited` with the header `Retry-After`. A token or a person keeps at most 8 streams open.

## Errors

An error is a `application/problem+json` document (RFC 9457). Decide on its `code`, never on `detail`, whose text can change:

```json
{
  "type": "about:blank",
  "title": "Not Found",
  "status": 404,
  "detail": "queue `main` not found",
  "code": "queue_not_found"
}
```

Each route lists the codes that it can answer. Every code:

| Code | Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid_request` | 400 | The body, the path or the query of the request is not valid. |
| `limit_out_of_range` | 400 | `limit` is from 1 to 100. |
| `invalid_cursor` | 400 | `from` is not a `cursor` that this list gave. |
| `unknown_priority` | 400 | The name of the priority is not `urgent`, `high`, `medium` or `low`. |
| `me_needs_session` | 400 | `@me` names the person of a session; an API token stands for no person. |
| `queue_needs_repo` | 400 | `queue` names a queue of the repository that `repo` names. |
| `unauthorized` | 401 | No API token or session, or one that is unknown or expired. |
| `scope_missing` | 403 | The token, or the role of the user of the session, lacks the scope of the route. |
| `csrf_refused` | 403 | A request of a session that can change a state lacks the header `X-CSRF-Token`, or carries another token than the cookie `__Host-cihub_csrf`. |
| `route_not_found` | 404 | No route has this path. |
| `org_not_found` | 404 | No organization has this slug, or the token or the user does not belong to it. |
| `repo_not_found` | 404 | The organization has no repository with this name. |
| `queue_not_found` | 404 | The repository has no queue with this name. |
| `pr_not_found` | 404 | The PR was never submitted to a queue of the repository. |
| `run_not_found` | 404 | The organization has no run with this identifier. |
| `queue_not_accepting` | 409 | The queue is `draining` or `switching_modes`: it accepts no new PR. |
| `pr_already_queued` | 409 | The PR is already in a queue of the repository, and its item has not ended. |
| `item_ended` | 409 | The item of the PR ended: `merged`, `failed` or `cancelled`. |
| `item_not_in_test` | 409 | Only an item in `testing` or `pending_failure` can restart its tests. |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | The token or the session made 600 requests in the minute: retry after `Retry-After` seconds. |
| `too_many_streams` | 429 | The token or the person already keeps 8 streams open. |
| `internal` | 500 | The server failed; the logs of the instance say why. |

The PRs in the queues of the organization: the current submission of each
PR in each queue, with the PRs that merge before it and an estimate.
Without a filter, every PR, live or ended.

**Scope**: `queues:read`, for an API token or for the role of the user of a session.

AuditEntry.description: An action of an admin, or a change of a queue.

actor_user_id.description: The user who acted; `null` for an API token.

before.description: What the target was before the action, when it matters.

target.description: The identifier of what the action changed: a queue or an item.

AuditList.description: A page of the audit log, newest first.

count.description: How many entries the list has, every page together.

cursor.description: The `from` of the next page; `null` on the last page.

ConfigCheck.description:
`GET /orgs/{org}/repos/{repo}/queues/{queue}/config-check`: the last
check of the configuration of the SCM; no finding means a sound
configuration.

checked_at.description:
When CIHub checked the configuration; `null` before the first check,
which comes within minutes of the creation of the queue.

findings.description: What the configuration misses; empty for a sound configuration.

Dependent.description: A live run whose predecessors hold a PR of this run.

run_id.description: The identifier of the live run.

ErrorCode.description:
The machine code of an error: a client decides on it, never on
`detail`. Each code has one HTTP status.

Event.description: An event of the log of a queue about a PR.

actor.description:
The login of the person who acted, or whose request caused the
decision; `null` when CIHub or an API token did.

actor_kind.description:
`system` for CIHub, `bot` for the account that CIHub acts with on the
SCM, `user` for a person.

description.description:
What happened, in English, for a person, where a check or a condition
is a Markdown code span; it can change without notice, unlike `type`
and `payload`.

item_id.description: The submission of the PR that the event concerns.

payload.description: The facts of the event, whose fields depend on `type`.

seq.description: The sequence number of the event in the log of the queue.

EventList.description: A page of the events of a PR, oldest first.

count.description: How many entries the list has, every page together.

cursor.description: The `from` of the next page; `null` on the last page.

Finding.description: A point of the configuration of the SCM that the queue needs.

message.description: What to change, in English, for a person.
message.example: add the App to the bypass list of the ruleset, in exempt mode

Graph.description:
The merge graph: the head of the target branch, the live items, the
predecessors that their tests merge before them, and the live runs.

edges.description:
An edge from each predecessor of a live item, which its test merges
before it.

nodes.description: The live items, in the order of the queue.

runs.description: The last run of each live group, the oldest first.

target_head_sha.description:
The head of the target branch that the queue saw last; `null` before
the first.

GraphEdge.description: The test of `to` merges `from` before it.

to.description: The identifier of the item whose test merges `from` first.

GraphNode.description: A live item of the graph.

position.description: The order in the queue, lower first; `null` before the admission.

pr_number.description: The number of the PR in its repository.

GraphRun.description:
A run of the graph: the items that it tests, on top of their
predecessors.

attempt.description:
From 1; a run tested again within the failure budget has a higher
attempt.

item_ids.description: The items that the run tests.

predecessor_ids.description: The items that the test branch merges before them.

app_install_url.description:
The page of the SCM that installs the App on an account, or chooses
the repositories of its installation; `null` when the SCM did not
answer.

ItemCounts.description: The current items of a queue in each state that is not terminal.

not_ready.description: Submitted, and blocked by a condition of the PR.

pending.description: Admitted, and waiting for a run.

pending_failure.description: In a run that failed, while the queue learns who is at fault.

tests_passed.description: Proved by a run, and waiting for the merge.

Org.description: An organization: the account of an installation of the App.

oneOf.description:
The role of the person of the session: `admin` has every scope,
`member` has `queues:read` and `prs:write`; `null` for an API token.

slug.description: The slug of the organization, as the routes name it.

OrgList.description: A page of the organizations of the person, by slug.

count.description: How many entries the list has, every page together.

cursor.description: The `from` of the next page; `null` on the last page.

Pr.description:
A PR in a queue: its last submission. A PR submitted again gets a new
submission, whose history its events keep.

author.description: The login of the author of the PR.

block_reasons.description:
What keeps a `not_ready` item out of the queue. Each one has a `kind`:
`review_required` (`have`, `need`), `changes_requested`,
`failing_required_check` (`check`), `awaiting_required_check`
(`check`, `status`), `behind_base`, `merge_conflict`,
`stack_needs_rebase` (`onto_pr_number`), `undetermined`, or
`queue_conditions_unmet` (`conditions`).

group_id.description: The identifier of the test group of the item; `null` outside a group.

head_sha.description: The head of the PR that the item tests.

merged_sha.description:
The commit that the merge of the PR created on the target branch;
`null` before the merge.

merges_in_seconds.description:
About how many seconds until it merges, from the median duration of
the runs of its queue; `null` when it does not move toward the merge,
or when its queue has no run that succeeded in the last 24 hours.

no_batch.description: The PR is tested alone, never in a batch.

number.description: The number of the PR in its repository.

position.description: The order in the queue, lower first; `null` before the admission.

queue.description: The name of the queue, as the routes name it.

queue_id.description: The identifier of the queue of the item.

repo.description: The name of the repository of the queue, as the routes name it.

run_id.description:
The last run of the group of the item: the run that tests it, or
that tested it last; `null` outside a group.

state_changed_at.description: When the item reached its state.

state_description.description:
The sentence of `state_reason`, in English, for a person; it can
change without notice, unlike `state_reason`.

state_reason.description:
Why the item reached its state: a code of the closed vocabulary
(`specs/DOMAIN.md`). A client decides on it.

submitted_by.description:
The login of the person who submitted the PR; `null` when CIHub or an
API token did.

submitted_via.description:
How the PR came into the queue: a `/cihub merge` comment, a label,
or the API.

title.description: The title at the last read of the PR; `null` before the first.

PrAhead.description: A PR ahead of another one in its queue.

pr_number.description: The number of the PR in its repository.

count.description: How many entries the list has, every page together.

cursor.description: The `from` of the next page; `null` on the last page.

PriorityInput.description:
The priority of a submission: a name (`urgent`, `high`, `medium`, `low`)
or a value from 0 to 255, lower first.

code.description: The machine code of the error: decide on it.

detail.description:
What went wrong with this request, in English, for a person; it can
change without notice, unlike `code`.

status.description: The HTTP status of the answer.

title.description: The reason phrase of the HTTP status.

Queue.description: A queue of a target branch, with its counters and its settings.

access.description: Whether CIHub reaches the repository of the queue on the SCM.

config_check.description: The last check of the configuration of the SCM that the queue needs.

config_error.description:
Why the last file read is not valid; the queue keeps the last valid
one.

config_sha.description: The head of the target whose configuration file the queue read last.

counts.description: The current items of the queue in each state that is not terminal.

failed_last_24h.description:
The current items that reached `failed` in the 24 hours before the
request.

failed_or_cancelled_last_24h.description:
The current items that reached `failed` or `cancelled` in the 24 hours
before the request, as the list of the PRs gives them.

has_config_file.description:
The target branch has a configuration file, valid or not; without
it, the queue takes the defaults.

last_merged_at.description: When the last current item reached `merged`; `null` if no item merged.

median_run_seconds.description:
The median duration of the runs that succeeded in the last 24 hours,
in seconds; `null` without such a run.

merged_last_24h.description:
The current items that reached `merged` in the 24 hours before the
request.

mode.description:
`single` tests every PR on top of all those ahead of it; `parallel`
only on top of those that change the same targets.

name.description: The name of the queue in its repository, as the routes name it.

repo.description: The name of the repository of the queue, as the routes name it.

repo_id.description: The identifier of the repository of the queue.

settings.description: The settings of the last valid configuration file.

state.description:
`running` accepts and merges; `paused` tests and merges nothing and
keeps the order, and a submission waits for the resume; `draining`
accepts nothing and lets the items in flight merge; `switching_modes`
behaves as `draining` until the queue is empty.

state_changed_at.description: When the queue reached its state; its creation before a first change.

state_changed_by.description:
The login of the person who asked for the state; `null` when CIHub
decided it, or when an API token asked for it.

strategy.description: The strategy of the last valid configuration file.

target_branch.description: The branch that the queue merges into.

target_head_sha.description:
The head of the target branch that the queue saw last; `null` before
the first.

window.description: How many runs the queue keeps in progress.

QueueAccess.description:
Whether CIHub reaches the repository of a queue on the SCM: `ok`, or
`suspended` when the App is suspended or uninstalled, and the queue is
paused until the access comes back.

QueueChanged.description:
The event `queue_changed` of `GET /orgs/{org}/stream`: what the pages of
the queue show changed, and they read it again.

queue_id.description: The identifier of the queue that changed.

seq.description:
The sequence number of the last event of the log of the queue; 0
before the first.

QueueList.description: A page of queues, by repository name then queue name.

count.description: How many entries the list has, every page together.

cursor.description: The `from` of the next page; `null` on the last page.

default_branch.description: The default branch of the repository.

name.description: The name of the repository, as the routes name it.

namespace.description: The account of the repository on the SCM.

RepoList.description: A page of repositories, by namespace then name.

count.description: How many entries the list has, every page together.

cursor.description: The `from` of the next page; `null` on the last page.

Run.description:
A run: one test, on the CI, of a test branch that CIHub assembles from
the head of the target branch, the PRs ahead (the predecessors), then the
PRs that it tests. The name of the test branch ends with the identifier of
the run.

attempt.description:
From 1; a run tested again within the failure budget has a higher
attempt.

base_sha.description: The head of the target branch that the test branch starts from.

checks.description: Every check and status observed on `test_sha`.

conflict_culprit.description:
What a member conflicts with, when the assembly of the test branch
failed: `{"kind": "queue_pr", "pr_number": 117}` or
`{"kind": "base_branch"}`.

dependents.description: The live runs whose predecessors hold a PR of this run.

draft_pr_number.description:
The draft PR that runs the CI of the test branch, when the
configuration asks for one.

ended_at.description: When the run ended; `null` while it runs.

failure_causing_statuses.description: The required checks that failed the run.

group_id.description: The identifier of the test group that the run tests.

head_shas.description: The heads merged in order: the predecessors, then the members.

impacted_targets.description: The targets that the tested PRs change (lot 13); `null` until then.

last_report_at.description: When CIHub saw the last report of a check of the run.

predecessor_pr_numbers.description: The PRs that the test branch merges before the tested ones.

queue_id.description: The identifier of the queue of the run.

required_statuses.description: The checks and statuses that the run needs to pass.

oneOf.description:
Where `required_statuses` come from: the configuration file, or the
protection of the target branch on the SCM.

status.description:
`assembling` while CIHub builds the test branch, `in_progress` while the
CI runs; then `succeeded`, `failed`, `timed_out`, `interrupted` when the
queue replaced the run, or `cancelled` when a member was cancelled.

status_reason.description:
Why the run reached its status: a code of the closed vocabulary
(`specs/DOMAIN.md`).

test_branch.description: The branch that the run tests, which CIHub assembles.

test_sha.description: The commit that the run tests; `null` while CIHub assembles it.

tested_pr_numbers.description: The PRs that the run tests.

RunCheck.description: A check or a status observed on the test SHA of a run.

oneOf.description: The outcome; `null` while the check runs.

details_url.description: The page of the check on the CI.

kind.description: `check` for a check with a run, `status` for a commit status.

name.description: The name of the check or of the status.

observed_at.description: When CIHub saw this report last.

required.description: The run needs it to pass.

SettingsSummary.description:
The settings of a queue that its page shows, from its last valid
configuration file.

batching_enabled.description: The queue tests several PRs in one run.

batching_max_wait_minutes.description: How long a batch that is not full waits for more PRs, in minutes.

batching_size.description: The most PRs in one batch.

enqueue_label.description:
The label that submits a PR when someone adds it; `null` when the
labels do not submit (`label_commands.enabled: false`).

failure_budget_retries.description: How many times a run that fails is tested again before its PRs fail.

merge_method.description: How the queue merges a PR into the target branch.

direct.description:
Merge the PR without a test of the queue; the person needs the
permission `admin` on the repository.

no_batch.description: Test the PR alone, never in a batch.

oneOf.description: Without it, the `priority_rules` of the configuration file decide.

queue.description:
The queue of the repository; without it, the base branch of the PR
chooses, as for a command in a comment.

state.description:
`running` resumes the queue; `paused` stops its tests and its merges
and keeps its order; `draining` lets the items in flight merge and
refuses new ones.

User.description: `GET /user`: the person of a session of the dashboard.

avatar_url.description:
The address of the image of the person on the SCM, `null` when the SCM
gives none.

login.description: The login of the person on the SCM.

name.description: The name that the person gives on the SCM, `null` when they give none.

Window.description: The speculation window: how many runs the queue keeps in progress.

ceiling.description: The largest size of the window.

current.description: The size of the window now, from `floor` to `ceiling`.

floor.description: The smallest size of the window.

tags.name: Session
tags.description: The person signed in to the dashboard, and the instance.

tags.name: Organizations
tags.description: An organization is the account of an installation of the App: its repositories and its audit log.

tags.name: Live updates
tags.description: The changes of the queues of an organization, as server-sent events.

tags.name: Queues
tags.description: A queue merges the PRs of one target branch, in order, once each one passed its tests on top of those ahead of it.

tags.name: Pull requests
tags.description: A PR in a queue, as its last submission gives it; a PR submitted again gets a new submission, whose history its events keep.

tags.name: Runs
tags.description: A run tests, on the CI, a test branch that holds a group of PRs on top of the PRs ahead of them.
